modules.heading: Content has evolved. Your tools should too.
modules.subheading: Publishing regularly is no longer enough. Algorithms weigh consistency, topical relevance and how people behave. PRIZMA builds the formats you need from a single topic, each one tuned to its channel.

items.name: Post
items.desc: A post that shows what your company can do. Not just an image, but a statement that stays in the feed and builds trust.

items.name: Reel
items.desc: Short-form video with a clear message. Algorithms distribute it organically. The most direct route to new reach, with no ad budget.

items.name: Carousel
items.desc: Complex ideas, broken down clearly. Carousels earn saves and shares. The kind of content people bookmark and come back to.

items.name: Story
items.desc: Short, current and casual. Stories keep your channels alive between the bigger posts, and they are what people see first.

items.name: Article
items.desc: Long-form content built for search. PRIZMA maps real queries, applies SEO and GEO logic, and structures articles that rank and hold attention.

items.name: Avatar
items.desc: A face for your brand, with no camera and no shoot. The AI avatar delivers your script on video, regularly and at consistent quality.

why.heading: Not a text generator. A system that runs your channels.
why.text: Most tools produce text and stop there, which leaves the work with you. PRIZMA takes on the whole chain: it turns your topics into the right formats, applies SEO and GEO signals, publishes them on your channels and learns from what works. Every text is tuned to the way your company speaks, with no robotic tone and no filler. The final call is always yours.
